Instituto Riva-Aguero (PUCP) 2027 research-support becas: individual (PEN 10,000) and group (PEN 20,000) grants of up to 10 months, open to the institute's own members to carry out their own research projects within the institute's research lines. The award funds the applicant's own project and names no supervising professor; official convocatoria page lists only the programme contact evelyn.sotomayor@pucp.pe.
